title: Customer refund policy
text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase for Cloud and Support plans. Licenses are refundable within 14 days only if the license key was never activated. Refunds above 5000 USD require approval from the finance controller. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days.

title: Travel and expense policy
text: Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. Hotel spend is capped at 220 USD per night in Dubai, Riyadh and London and 120 USD per night elsewhere. Expense claims must be submitted with receipts within 30 days of travel. Meals are reimbursed up to 60 USD per day.

title: Data retention standard
text: Raw event data in the bronze layer is retained for 90 days. Curated silver and gold tables are retained for 7 years for finance data and 2 years for product telemetry. Customer support transcripts are deleted after 18 months. Backups follow the same retention windows as their source tables.

title: Remote access and VPN guide
text: To request VPN access open a ticket in the IT portal under the access category and attach manager approval. VPN sessions expire after 12 hours. Multi factor authentication with the authenticator app is mandatory. Split tunneling is disabled on company laptops.

title: Annual leave policy
text: Full time employees receive 25 days of annual leave per year. Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year and must be used by the end of March. Leave requests longer than 10 consecutive days need approval two weeks in advance.

title: Procurement approval thresholds
text: Purchases under 2000 USD can be approved by a team lead. Purchases between 2000 and 25000 USD require department head approval and two vendor quotes. Purchases above 25000 USD require a procurement committee review and a signed contract before any payment.

title: Incident severity levels
text: Sev1 means a customer facing outage or data loss and pages the on call engineer immediately with a 15 minute response target. Sev2 means degraded service with a 1 hour response target. Sev3 is a minor defect handled in business hours. Every Sev1 requires a written postmortem within 5 business days.

title: Personal data handling rules
text: Personal data such as names, emails and phone numbers must be masked in analytics tables. Unmasked access requires a data protection approval and is logged. Exports of personal data to spreadsheets are not allowed. Test environments must use synthetic or tokenized data only.

title: Laptop refresh program
text: Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years. Engineers may request a refresh after 2 years if the device has less than 16 GB of memory. Old devices must be returned to IT for secure wipe within 14 days of receiving a replacement.

title: Password and credential rotation
text: Service account secrets must be stored in the key vault and rotated every 90 days. Human passwords need at least 14 characters. Shared accounts are not permitted. Credentials found in source code must be revoked within 24 hours.

title: Vendor onboarding checklist
text: New vendors must complete a security questionnaire, provide a tax certificate and sign the data processing agreement before onboarding. Vendors handling personal data need an annual security review. Onboarding usually takes 15 business days.

title: Legacy system decommission plan
text: The legacy fax gateway is owned by the Platform Operations team and is scheduled for shutdown in September. The old reporting server is owned by the BI team and will be retired after the lakehouse migration. Questions about legacy systems go to the platform operations channel.

title: On call rotation runbook
text: Each engineering team runs a weekly on call rotation that starts on Monday at 09:00 Gulf time. The on call engineer must acknowledge pages within 15 minutes. Handover notes are posted in the team channel. Compensation for on call weeks is a fixed allowance plus time off in lieu.

title: Compensation bands and salary review
text: Salary bands are reviewed every January. Band placement is decided by the compensation committee. Individual salary data is confidential and restricted to the HR business partners.
